name: How To Get Saved
overview: Salvation is granted to those who receive and believe in Jesus Christ, granting them the privilege to become children of God. Entrance into God's kingdom requires being born of water and the Spirit, highlighting the necessity of spiritual rebirth. Jesus is the exclusive way to the Father, and salvation cannot be found through any other name. Belief in the Lord Jesus Christ is the essential step to being saved, as demonstrated by the promise of eternal life for all who trust in Him.
